title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. A) In my company we outsource a lot of work to other companies. Will it be OK, if I as an employee create a new company and take some of this outsourced work while at the same time I remain in employment with my company. I would like to point that me creating a new company will not effect my work with the company I am employed with as I shall hire people to do the outsourced work in the company I create and it will all together act as a seperate entity from myself? B) Would it be OK to outsource the work I take to some other companies further, even though they might have been my competitor in the bidding stages of getting the outsourced work from the company I am employed with? C) Another case that I am thinking of is instead of creating a new company, I bid/take the outsourced work under the banner of the company of my friend. However, my friend says that if I do decide to use his company's name and office, then I have to pay him 15% of the profit I make and incase of a loss I dont pay him anything. Will it be halaal if I agree to this in exchange for using his office facilities and company name? 1617 views Q. Assalam-U-Alaikum. I want to know whether there is a permission in Islam to purchase a car on Installments. As per my knowledge, under installment scheme, you are supposed to pay the actual cost fixed intrest per month. But the cost is predecided by the bank for eg. if the vehicle cost is 4 lakhs, and if you are paying the installments in 3 years, bank will calculate the intrest and give you the final figure of 5.5 lakhs. So the cost of the car is 5.5 lakhs for you, which you are supposed to pay in 3 years. But if you change your plan of making payment in 4 years, then the total value of car will increase. So Please let me know whether we can purchase a car on installment. I can not buy a car by paying entire amount in cash, and car is very important for me to buy. Will be thankful to you for your advise. 2156 views Q. I went to a car financer, he gave me the following break up; on road price 8,42,000rs loan amount 5,90,000 monthly instalments for 3 years 19,765. So ultimate price of vehicle will be 9,64,480rs, an excess of 1,21,540rs. If i keep all my instalments on time is this deal allowed, he says that he has calculated the above on a interest rate of 12%, but for me it is just extra profit for him helping me to but the car, regardless of what he calls it if I keep up the payments the deal will be exactly as mentioned and no change shall occur. 1725 views Q. Currently there is a difference of opinion regarding what is known as ?Islamic Banking.? There are some ulama that are of the opinion that this type of banking and the services that they provide are halaal and a practicing Muslim should have not fear and fully take advantage of the variety of services being offered by these same banks. On the other hand there are a group of scholars that aver that this type of banking is no different than regular commercial non Islamic banks. The only differences being in the terminology, but the actual transactions fall into the category of riba. Our question to the ulama ikram is: in the opinion of your darul iftaa, which group is correct, as both can not be correct in this case. Please explain your fatwa completely which will eliminate the doubts in the minds of the common people. 2588 views Q. assalamualikua STATE BANK OF HYDERABAD PEOPLE ARE ASKING MY PROPERTY FOR RENT I REQUEST YOU TO SEND FATWA TO GIVE OR NOT AND ATM ALSO SEND WITH DETAILS KHUDA HAFIZ 2089 views Q. Question: We have own house. 3rd floor of the house is not build yet. Our neighbor offered us to construct the 3rd floor, He give total cost as a condition that he stay one apartment as rent free for next three years. This floor will became 4 apartment. Another 3 apartment we give rent others tenant. After 3 years we paid her full money which he give for build house and he leave home. My question, is it permissible in islam? Mention that: 1. He get back her full money after 3 years which he give for constructing house as he benefited he will stay rent free. 2. We collect her money from rent price of the rest 3 apartment. 3. If we deny he may keep money in bank and get interest and the interest become close to rent price per month. Please answer as soon as possible. Answer ID: 27457 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2102/1699/B=1431) Islam does not allow it. It is not lawful for creditor to avail residential facility by giving debt. According to Islam, it is interest. It is mentioned in Hadith: كل قرض جر نفعاً فهو ربوا (1) It is unlawful for them as mentioned above. (2) It is right for you to collect money from the rent of other three flats. (3) They will be sinful if they get benefit from your flats for three years by giving you money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
